# Financial model: output (generated by financial_model.py)
Exchange rate [A]: 1 USD = 0.87 EUR. 'Profit' = pre-tax profit per month in EUR. 'Revenue' = gross marketplace revenue in USD. Hours = estimated owner hours per week. Atlassian fee: 0% until $1M lifetime revenue; at €50k/month you cross that after ~17 months, after which 17% applies (~20% more revenue needed for the same profit).
